fusions.name: Palmed and Thrown
fusions.desc: Throws a palmed blade that deals 5 damage, with 50% more critical chance against a target that has not yet been hurt.

fusions.name: Slipped Between Ribs
fusions.desc: Slides the edge in where the guard is thinnest, dealing 30 damage as a critical hit and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Edge Out of Hiding
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Already Drawn
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your next strike gains 30% critical hit chance. Once every 6 seconds.
